capabilities: Record thought paths as Markdown list files
Edit node titles and bodies directly on the graph
Reuse existing nodes via typed suggestions
Rearrange nodes with drag, pan, and zoom gestures
Convert legacy adjacency/--- files to the arrow format
disambiguation: Not a general vault link visualizer; it graphs thought paths written as indented arrow lists inside one Markdown file per thought.
extras: Older adjacency/--- format files must be converted once before switching versions, with backups written to a backup directory; warns users to keep normal vault backups since edits modify Markdown files.
problem: Obsidian's graph views are read-only overviews of links and don't let you build and edit thought paths node by node on a canvas.
summary: Thought-recording plugin that stores paths as plain Markdown lists and renders them as an editable, reusable-node graph.
